releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric mod that makes **JEI** display the [Matcha Flavoured](https://modrinth.com/datapack/matcha-flavoured) datapack's reskinned items (vanilla items costumed via `item_model`/`item_name` components) and their smithing/crafting recipes.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 + Fabric API
- JEI 30.14.x
- The Matcha Flavoured datapack + resource pack

**Install:** drop `matcha-flavoured-jei-compat-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder (client-side only).

Note: this only teaches JEI to display the pack — the datapack itself must be loaded in your world (`saves/<world>/datapacks/`). See the README.
